chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
The city is easy to walk.
Part six, streets and old houses.
The city invites you to stop.
Verona is the city of love.
Part eight, daily life of people.
Part nine, food and Italian taste.
Part twelve, the soul of Verona and goodbye Verona is romantic.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
See you in the next journey.
